purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign082, before opening any Campaign083 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

definition_only_source_boundary.source: immutable accepted local Tushare 2019-2025 one-minute source and joint-clean stock-day identity

candidate_design_catalog.reason: The share of within-half minutes that strictly establish a new running close high or low measures repeated price-frontier discovery. It discards innovation magnitude and direction, resets at lunch, and is not an ordinary price-update rate, extreme-arrival clock, terminal location, path-efficiency statistic, high-low interval frontier, or fitted trend.

Subtracting new-low from new-high counts would reopen signed trend and direction-search families already represented by terminal close location, signed path efficiency, breakout pressure, and extreme-arrival order.
Last record time is another absolute extreme-timing or recency statistic after terminal extreme-arrival and peak-recency mechanisms.
High/low boundary expansion is already represented by the terminal two-sided range-frontier factor; changing expansion magnitude to counts would be a same-family rescue.
Weighting record events by breakout size would mix the selected topology with path efficiency, range expansion, or breakout pressure and introduce an avoidable transform choice.
Cross-day lags, thresholds, filters, subsets, regime splits, residualization, fitting, models, and combinations are outside this one-factor campaign.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_close_frontier_innovation_share_238p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Repeated strict expansion of the within-half-session close frontier indicates continuing information incorporation rather than price revisitation; a session with broader sequential price discovery may retain directional attention over the next three sessions even though the factor deliberately discards whether discovery was upward or downward.
selected_candidate.formula: For each independent 120-close half, initialize running_min=running_max at its first close. For each of the next 119 positions, record one innovation exactly when close_t is strictly greater than the preceding running_max or strictly less than the preceding running_min, then update both frontiers. Sum innovations across the two halves and divide by exactly 238.
selected_candidate.time_grid: Exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. The raw 09:30 row remains part of source identity but is excluded. The afternoon frontier restarts at 13:01; no lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock transition exists.
selected_candidate.tie_rule: Equality to either preceding running frontier is not an innovation. Comparisons are exact float64 comparisons with no epsilon, tick rounding, jitter, or stochastic tie handling.
selected_candidate.source_semantics: All 240 selected closes must be finite and strictly positive. A constant half or constant full day is valid and contributes zero innovations rather than missing.
selected_candidate.availability: Known at the signal-session close after the exact 240 close bars; no future session, daily return, comparison value, or Candidate49 observation is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
